recovery_reason: fixes: 01 AI-Researcher wrapper now exports TDC_ADMET_TOX_NATIVE_RUN=1 into FRAMEWORK_DOCKER_ARGS so the adapter's context bound is active (previous runs omitted the env var; r2 01 died at ~30 min with litellm 400 'Range of input length should be [1, 262144]' because context was unbounded). 05 DeepScientist: codex CLI 0.130.0 announces MCP servers as tools of type 'namespace' (mcp__artifact__/mcp__bash_exec__/mcp__memory__); relay _translate_responses_tools only handled function/custom and silently dropped namespace entries, so the model never received artifact.confirm_baseline and looped on shell_command with baseline_gate stuck pending in every previous batch. relay.py now expands namespace tools into prefixed function tools (mcp__artifact__confirm_baseline etc., 60 tools total) and the host relay was restarted with the fix; per-run relays mount the same file. Only frameworks 01 and 05 are rerun; 02/04 failed in framework/model code (log_summarization unpack error; generated experiment code missing import os) and are not part of this batch.
